notFromSource.reason: Thunder's Edge rulebook; absent from the source at this commit

factionTechnologies.fields: data/factions factionTech; data/technologies name, types, requirements, source; data/units requiredTechId for what a unit upgrade upgrades.
factionTechnologies.reason: Executive Order is filed under keleres with source thunders_edge but listed on no faction; the Thunder's Edge rulebook gives Keleres two faction technologies and the source names the Keleres breakthrough I.I.H.Q. Modernization, so it is taken to replace that technology (inference, not confirmed by a rulebook line).

mapLayouts.source: Prophecy of Kings rulebook, official PDF from the FFG product page (ti10_rulebook_web-good.pdf)

pages.9: Game Board Setup for 5, 7, or 8 players; Hyperlane Setup
pages.12: Map Appendix: Alternate Hyperlanes, Large Galaxy

mapLayouts.fromSource: Three to six players and the five-player hyperlanes: data/map_templates (6pStandard, 3pInPersonHyperlanes, 5pHyperlanes); homes of three to six players and the three- and four-player hyperlanes: Milty Draft (MILTY_HOMES, MILTY_LANES).
mapLayouts.reason: The source has no rulebook map for seven or eight players or for the Large Galaxy (its 7pHyperlanes and 8pHyperlanes are Milty Draft maps): slots, homes and lanes were copied by hand from the diagrams, twin sides assigned in the order of the rulebook list.

tokenUnits.reason: Fighters and infantry are not limited by their figures: tokens stand in for them (LRR 96 note 2.1), so their limit is null.

components.texts: Card texts are copied verbatim into src/data/texts/<pack>.json (component id to text); they belong to the publisher, see src/data/texts/NOTICE.md. Only line ends are unified and the ends trimmed.

fields.action_cards: alias, name, text, source; phase and window in detail; identical cards (name and text) are one component with copies
fields.agendas: alias, name, source; text1 and text2 as the paragraphs of the text (Covert Legislation has neither: its text is its target); type (law, directive) and target in detail
fields.relics: alias, name, text, source; isFakeRelic excludes
fields.explores: id, name, text, source; type as detail.trait, resolution; identical cards are one component with copies; attachmentId with the numbers of data/attachments (resourcesModifier, influenceModifier, techSpeciality) in detail
fields.attachments: read only for the numbers of exploration cards; an attachment is no component of its own
fields.promissory_notes: alias, name, text, source, faction; the five common notes keep the "<color>" of the source in id and text
fields.public_objectives: alias, name, text, source; points as detail.stage and detail.points, phase
fields.secret_objectives: alias, name, text, source; phase and points in detail
fields.technologies: text; every common technology of the official sources is in the pack of its source; the text of a starting technology is also in the pack of the faction that starts with it
fields.abilities: permanentEffect, then window and windowEffect joined by a colon, as paragraphs
fields.leaders: abilityWindow and abilityText joined by a colon; unlockCondition under <id>#unlock unless it is "Always Unlocked"
fields.units: ability: of a mech under mech:<id>, of a ship under unit:<id>
fields.strategy_cards: primaryTexts and secondaryTexts, each joined by line ends, under strategy:<id> and strategy:<id>#secondary, in the pack of the set (base_game, pok, te) that holds the card

components.notRead: flavorText, notes (rulings of the source), image and automation fields

excluded.promissory:rider: filed under "keleres", which is no faction of the packs; the same card is there for each of its three factions

components.excludedReason: Only base, pok, codex* and thunders_edge from the official files are kept; every other source is homebrew or a variant of the source itself.

factionTechnologiesNotNamed.reason: faction technologies of an official source that no faction entry lists

sameTextAs.reason: Ta Zern is not in the source at this commit; its text is assumed to be that of Agnlan Oln, which replaces it. Not confirmed by a public source.

production.spacedock: Production of a space dock is the planet's resources plus the number in its levels: source productionValue, LRR 79.1.
